purpose: Four independent short warm organic liquid blob one-shots for individual Main fire extinctions
notes: Four distinct prompts and seeds produce independent original float masters through the cached pinned official MLX pipeline. Selected real event excerpts are documented transparently, with no substitute synthesis, pitch/speed changes, duplicated-offset variations, or external audio.

assets.title: Warm liquid blob
assets.role: Short soft rounded warm resonant liquid plop
assets.prompt: TrackType: SFX, One single small soft rounded liquid blob plop, warm hollow wet bubble resonance with a brief gentle organic attack and a smooth short downward settling watery decay. A close intimate low middle frequency bloop, soft restrained upper frequencies, tactile and calm, no hard click or splash. A single isolated sound surrounded by quiet, dry clean acoustics, no hiss, fire, music or voices. Length: 5 seconds.
